# Arkency - Ruby on Rails Development & Consulting

Arkency is a Ruby on Rails consultancy helping companies rescue, modernize, and scale Rails applications.  
Core focus: legacy modernization, upgrades, Domain-Driven Design, event-driven architecture, and long-term product support.

Proof points from arkency.com:
- Rails expertise since 2006
- 5.0/5 on Clutch
- 8.5k+ developers educated

Extended profile: [llms-full.txt](https://arkency.com/llms-full.txt)

## Services

- [Custom Ruby on Rails Development](https://arkency.com/ruby-on-rails-custom-software-development/) - New features, architecture, legacy rescue
- [Ruby on Rails Upgrades](https://arkency.com/ruby-on-rails-upgrades/) - Safe upgrades with minimal disruption
- [Fintech Solutions](https://arkency.com/ruby-on-rails-fintech/) - Financial data architecture, event-driven approach
- [Frontend Development](https://arkency.com/ruby-on-rails-frontend-development/) - React + Hotwire for Rails products
- [Code Mentoring](https://arkency.com/code-mentoring/) - Hands-on technical mentoring
- [DDD Workshop](https://arkency.com/ddd-workshops/) - Rails + Domain-Driven Design training
- [Event Storming Workshop](https://arkency.com/event-storming-workshops-for-ruby-on-rails/) - Collaborative domain modeling
- [Hotwire Workshop](https://arkency.com/hotwire-workshop/) - Full-day Hotwire training for Rails teams
